in_sanskrit.name: देवमानंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one born of or given by the Gods. Deva means God and Manas means mind. Māna means thinking and Nāsh means born.

in_hindi.name: देवमानंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (God) से उत्पन्न (born) या देवोंसे मिला (given) हुआ।

in_tamil.name: திவமானான்ஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: திவன் (God) அவரிடம் (from) அவர்களிடம் (from them) உட்பட்ட (born) அல்லது (or) உழைப்பது (given) இருந்தால் இந்த முகம் (this name).

in_telugu.name: దేవమానంశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవాదు (Gods) ఆదే (from) అవదే (them) ఉద్యోజీ (born) యొజిజేశ్వరు (or) పోజేశ్వరు (given) ఇహ ముఖ్యముఖే (this name).

in_marathi.name: Devmanansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods, Lord of Lords
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devmanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devmanansh is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning God and ‘Manas’ meaning mind or intellect. This name signifies the God of Gods or the Lord of Lords, who is the supreme being and the ruler of all minds and intellects.
